sn9.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū Kosalesu viharanti aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || Atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu || || Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā te bhikkhū apassantī paridevamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn9.4:2.1: Arati viya me-jja khāyati || bahuke disvāna vivitte āsane || te cittakathā bahussutā || ko-me Gotama-savakā gatā ti || ||
sn9.4:3.1: Evaṃ vutte aññatarā devatā taṃ devataṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.4:4.1: Magadhaṃ gatā Kosalaṃ gatā || ekacciyā pana Vajja-bhūmiyā || magā viya asaṅgacārino || aniketā viharanti bhikkhavo ti || ||
